policy.public_payload_rule: Git, public OCI images, public CI caches, and public release artifacts may contain only exact components whose applicable license permits that distribution and whose required notices, source, and device-use conditions are satisfied.
policy.license_acceptance_rule: The project buys no license, subscription, or paid service. Each person accepts no-cost vendor terms for their own downloads; project automation may use a no-cost proprietary input only after the maintainer confirms acceptance of its exact recorded terms. CI recipes may consume that recorded confirmation but must not silently accept terms, transfer acceptance to students, or expose acceptance state or credentials to fork jobs.
release_evidence: exact artifact version, canonical URL, and SHA-256
SPDX SBOM for the actual distributed filesystem or archive
corresponding-source or source-offer evidence where required
post-link firmware component and runtime-library inventory
maintainer approval for every non-open or ambiguous component

satisfy copyleft corresponding-source duties for the exact binaries

generate a schema-valid SPDX document rather than trusting the companion filename
